flow.body: Hi, Ina {app_name}, an AI banking assistant that can help you with your banking needs. To get started, please complete the onboarding form below.

pre_onboarding.greeting: Barka da zuwa {app_name}. Zan iya taimakawa da transfers, airtime/data, balances, da transaction history. Da farko, mu kammala account setup ɗinka.
pre_onboarding.inquiry: Setup yana taimaka min tabbatar da kai da haɗa bank accounts ɗinka cikin aminci. Bayananka suna encrypted kuma ana amfani da su don verification kawai.
pre_onboarding.compliance: Madalla. Danna maballin da ke sama don ci gaba da account setup ɗinka.
pre_onboarding.objection: Na fahimci damuwarka. Setup ya zama dole kafin in iya duba banking information ko taimaka da transactions.
pre_onboarding.banking_request: Zan iya taimakawa da hakan idan setup ya kammala. Da farko, mu gama account setup ɗinka.
pre_onboarding.out_of_scope: Ina mayar da hankali kan banking. Don amfani da Nenya, da fatan za ka kammala account setup ɗinka tukunna.
pre_onboarding.cooldown: Zan kasance a nan idan ka shirya. Danna maballin a kowane lokaci don ci gaba da setup.
